project.name: sdk-js
project.note: Multi-repo project. lumera provides chain types. sdk-js (this) provides JS/TS client library for blockchain and Cascade storage.

decisions.module_queries: RPC (via Telescope-generated clients) for Action and Supernode
decisions.rq_processing: rq-library-wasm (single-block layouts, LEP-1 IDs) in Web Worker when available
decisions.signing: Wallet ADR-036 for off-chain bytes; CosmJS signDirect/signAmino for tx

handoff.stopped_at: SDK v0.2.7 published. Core features implemented. On everlight branch but no Everlight-specific features yet.
handoff.next_immediate: Everlight SDK work will begin when lumera publishes tagged Everlight release. Will need updated Telescope codegen for Everlight query types.
handoff.watch_out: Proto codegen depends on lumera proto definitions. When Everlight protos are tagged, re-run Telescope codegen.

recent_decisions: 2026-04-06: BRIDGE context normalized to standard schema. Previous non-standard context.json (generated 2025-10-22) content preserved in as_built section.
